regions.name: Northern Areas
regions.where: Northern Mozambique (purple on the locator map): Niassa and Cabo Delgado, north of the Lúrio river
regions.notes: Lean box drawn in two pieces (Dec and Jan-Mar), recorded as one Dec-Mar season. Cyclone season, green harvest (Apr), labour and milk bars not recorded.

regions.name: Central Areas
regions.where: Central Mozambique (purple on the locator map): Tete, Manica, Sofala, Zambezia and Nampula, down to the Save river
regions.notes: Rainy season shaded Nov to mid-Apr. Lean box drawn in two pieces (Nov-Dec and Jan-Feb), recorded as one Nov-Feb season. Cyclone season, green harvest (Mar), labour, vegetable and milk bars not recorded. Edges at or near a mid-month tick, counted as covering the month (share of that month covered in brackets): Rainy Season (Apr 50%).

regions.name: Southern Areas
regions.where: Southern Mozambique (purple on the locator map): Gaza, Inhambane, Maputo province and Maputo City, south of the Save river
regions.notes: Lean box drawn in two pieces (Oct-Dec and Jan), recorded as one Oct-Jan season. Planting starts on the mid-Oct tick. Cyclone season, green harvest (Feb), labour, vegetable and milk bars not recorded. Edges at or near a mid-month tick, counted as covering the month (share of that month covered in brackets): Planting (Oct 49%).

assign.method: Provinces read off the three locator maps, whose boundaries follow province lines (Lúrio river north/central, Save river central/south).

transcriber_notes: The image is cut at the right edge, a few pixels short of the end of the Dec column (under 5% of Dec missing); bars and shading that reach the edge were taken to run to the end of Dec.
